pages.title: Grape Ape
pages.text: $(bold)Base THC:$() 18% — $(bold)Base CBD:$() 7%$(br)$(bold)Effect:$() Aroused (10 seconds)$(br)$(bold)Extra Effects:$() None (THC ≤ 20)$(br)$(br)Warped Fungus from the Nether required.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Synthesizer Reagents:$()$(br)Brown Mushroom + Butter + Warped Fungus
Grind Grape Ape Buds in the Grinder (2 weed) or Manual Grinder (1 weed).
Plant on farmland or in a Grow Pot. Harvest at age 10. Get seeds via DNA route or Mutator.
Pack weed into a bag for selling to the Stoner Villager or compact storage.
